suggested_patch.details: Merged plan contains zero tasks; nothing to critique for inflated benchmarks, test-heavy violations, missing edge cases, spec_author validity, or dependency cycles. Confirm whether this is the intended end-state (e.g., all candidates filtered out) or an upstream merge bug producing an empty task list.

findings.message: The merged plan's `tasks` array is empty. With no tasks present, the five required checks (inflated benchmark claims, test-heavy rule violations, missing edge cases, spec_author!=null misuse, dependency cycles) are all vacuously satisfied. This is reported as a warning because an empty merged plan is either (a) a legitimate result of all candidate tasks being rejected upstream, or (b) a symptom of a merge/serialization bug that dropped the task list. The planner should verify which scenario applies before treating the empty plan as final.
